title: docs(pm-dispatch): pin the cloud unlock probe and have triage complete a freeze itself
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbDeGPLQrs5C3RsEmkP8cErv)_

Fixes #31353
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 两条规则说清楚了。一是 cloud 解锁探针:写明在 objectstack 检出里跑,第一个 sha 是修复在 `main` 上的 squash 合并 commit,第二个是 cloud 仓 `.objectstack-sha` 文件里写的 sha;二是分诊入队前遇到冻结/hold,由分诊自己同笔挂 `pm:on-hold` 加引原文的 `Restart-when:`,写不出可执行判据才挂 `pm:retriage` 问所属车道。
- 为什么改:PR #31347 合约复核 6716750908 的两条 should-fix。探针原文三处可误读(在哪跑、pin sha 从哪来、写的是修复 sha 而非合并 sha);冻结规则原文让分诊挂一个由分诊自己回答的标签,等于没说答案。两处误读都只会多挡卡,不会误放。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `.claude/` 下两份参考文档,无代码、无发布面。每份文件的新增一行都用同文件删除一条在别处已写明的规则来付,行数上限不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` L40–41(冻结规则);`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L28–29(探针);两处被删的行(cross-repo 原 L41、triage-duties 原 L100)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,应看到两份文件 47/47 与 100/100 行、headroom 0,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,席位在总监席契约复核 PASS 后落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md`
- L28–29: the cloud unlock probe is `git merge-base --is-ancestor 合入sha PIN_SHA` (the file spells the placeholders in angle brackets), run in an objectstack checkout; 合入sha is the squash merge commit on `main` (a fix PR's own head is never an ancestor of the pin), and pin sha is the sha written inside `objectstack-ai/cloud`'s `.objectstack-sha`, not the file.
- Paid by deleting old L41 (`复核记录带 Implemented-by:/Reviewed-by:;改路由…只对未派发卡`). Both halves are already stated elsewhere: `references/lanes/review.md` L19 and `references/contract-review.md` L43 carry the `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` pair; `SKILL.md` L112 (`定车道与改路由限未派发卡`) and `references/execution-duties.md` L10 (`席改标限未派发卡`) carry the undispatched-only rule.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`
- L40–41: before a move into `pm:queue`, triage reads the latest transition comment; on a hold, freeze or ruling it lands `pm:on-hold` plus a `Restart-when:` quoting it in one write (`state-machine.md` L16), and files `pm:retriage` to ask the owning lane only when it cannot write an executable `Restart-when:`.
- Paid by deleting old L100 (`推送维护者只照 lanes/triage.md 推送清单;…`), a pointer whose rule `references/lanes/triage.md` L8–14 states in full (push only what needs the maintainer, the rest only into the seat post's round record).

`state-machine.md` is unchanged.

## Tests

Docs-only diff under `.claude/**`; no package moves, no test owed. Line widths re-measured: every touched line is at most 120 bytes (widest 120).

## Acceptance notes

- Nit 1 (the ratchet comment on the `triage-duties.md` ceiling still describes the main-green doorbell as two lines) is not taken: that comment lives in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, outside this card's two-file surface.
- Nit 2 (cross-repo L38 lost "immediately") is not taken: the shortest wording that restores it (`…贴上注明;有主即停。`) measures 125 bytes against the 120-byte line cap, so it is not line-neutral.
- The fallback clause (`pm:retriage` to the owning lane) keeps `state-machine.md` L40's remover: triage still removes the label, after the lane's answer supplies the `Restart-when:`.
